annotations.text: A — Neon Sign: leans hard into their actual branding — the cyan neon color, the navy "Restaurante" script pill, bold marquee-style type. Loud and proud, closest to the real storefront. Tradeoff: boldest color use, least "quiet."

B — Quiet Kitchen: minimal, one full-bleed photo of Chef Miguel, almost no color, restrained italic serif headline. Most confident/understated option. Tradeoff: doesn't show the food or the real logo colors up front.
C — Family Table: warm scrapbook collage of overlapping photos, handwritten accent, terracotta/cream tones. Most "home-cooked" feeling. Tradeoff: busiest layout, least formal.
